categories.name: Environment

categories.name: Maintenance
categories.description: The condition, functionality and repair of infrastructure, finishes and fixtures.

categories.name: Facilities
categories.description: Availability of resources and equipment, and signage that says the right message at the right place.

categories.name: Productivity & People
categories.description: Manpower deployment, utilisation and presence; queuing; retail service; correct uniform display and identification.

categories.name: Technology & Equipment
categories.description: Inventory and stock levels, lighting, and the functionality of equipment with emphasis on downtime.

categories.name: Safety
categories.description: All aspects pertaining to safety as it applies to the area and in relation to resource management.

categories.name: Waiting Time
categories.description: The processing time, expressed as a time value, for a passenger or consumer within a process.

categories.name: Flight Information
categories.description: Flight details recorded at the start of an observation, needed if an investigation takes place.

categories.name: Entry Questions
categories.description: Gate questions that confirm whether an area or asset is compliant before the detailed checks.

referenceLists.name: Airlines
referenceLists.description: Carriers auditors can pick on flight observations. A starting list: add, rename or deactivate to match each airport.

referenceLists.name: Aircraft Types
referenceLists.description: Aircraft types for flight observations. The group is the body type, filled in automatically when an auditor picks the aircraft.

referenceLists.name: Aircraft Body Types
referenceLists.description: Wide, narrow and Code F (A380, 748), as asked on the SSMM flight information.

referenceLists.name: Ground Handling Companies
referenceLists.description: Ramp handling companies. The one recorded on a flight audit is the service provider its ramp-handling questions are reported against.

referenceLists.name: Parking Bays
referenceLists.description: Parking bays and stands. Add them per airport; until an airport has bays listed, auditors type the bay number.

referenceLists.name: Service Providers
referenceLists.description: Named contractors, from the ACSA checklists. Used on template questions and sites so reports can show who was responsible.

referenceLists.name: Responsibilities
referenceLists.description: Who answers for a question. The first three are the SSMM key (0, 1, 2); the others come from the Responsible Contractor columns.
